title: MiceMax
tagline: The autonomous company that turns conference visitors into local customers

slides.title: Sapporo's conference visitors fly in, attend, fly out
slides.body:
Sapporo hosted **466 conferences and 109,311 attendees** in 2025.

Most attendees never plan anything: an unfamiliar city, a packed schedule, extra work. They come for the conference and leave. By suggesting them relevant activities of interest and additional stays, we can increase spending per visitor.

stat.label: estimated new local spending if Sapporo ran MiceMax across its conferences

slides.alt: MiceMax operations: AI agents passing work between each other
slides.caption: 18 agents run every conference, see them at mice-max.netlify.app/ops

slides.title: Every job in the company, done by an agent
steps: Sales: rank conferences, draft JA/EN outreach: a person approves before sending
Ingest: read the program, find free time slots, pick the right experiences. LLM proposes, graph curates.
Operations: voice booking, Q&A chat, snow-disruption replanning
Security: every action logged with model, tokens, cost, confidence
slides.body:
A typical company running this across Sapporo needs about **17 humans**.

 MiceMax runs the whole operation with **18 agents and 2 humans**.
